description.p: XXAR is a mod manager and mod creator for HoYoverse games. It can replace any sound inside Zenless Zone Zero, Genshin Impact and Honkai Star Rail with your own audio — without touching a command line.

ul.li: Mod Manager: install, enable/disable, and reorder audio mods per game
Audio Browser: browse every sound in the game with preview playback
Mod Creator: build your own .zzar / .giar / .srar mod packages
Audio Converter: convert between MP3, WAV, WEM and other formats
Loop point and per-replacement volume editing

description.p: Safer Honkai Star Rail voice-over handling and clearer apply results.

ul.li: Honkai Star Rail voice-over originals are now secured into the streaming folder together with their hash files, so mods survive game repairs and updates like in the other games
The audio browser automatically switches a voice-over tab to the secured copy after applying, no restart needed
Applying now reports mods whose target audio is not in your installation (for example voice content the game has not downloaded yet) instead of claiming success
Much less log noise while applying

description.p: Better sounding audio conversion and a crash fix.

ul.li: Loudness normalization no longer squashes the dynamics: a track that cannot reach the target level is now simply turned down instead of being compressed
Audio is converted at the highest Vorbis quality, so a replacement stays closer to the file you picked
Showing the list of changes in the browser no longer closes the app when there is nothing to show

description.p: New Windows installer and a smaller download.

ul.li: Windows: XXAR now ships with its own uninstaller, which shows how much space each part takes and lets you keep your mods and settings
Windows: the installer replaces the old MSI package, and updates install through it
The download is about 34 MB smaller: build leftovers are no longer bundled

description.p: Windows installer fix and build hardening.

ul.li: Windows: installing on a drive other than the one holding Windows no longer fails with "Could not set file security" (error 1926/1307)
Windows: the executable now carries proper version details and is no longer compressed

description.p: Fixes Patch.pck corruption and misplaced voice-mod overlays.

ul.li: Muting a Patch.pck sound no longer corrupts the live file and its backup
Voice-mod overlays land in the correct language subfolder and stray root-level copies are cleaned up automatically
Patch.pck backups are verified against the game's own manifest before being captured

description.p: HIRC Editor mod import, Patch.pck browser fix, and quality-of-life improvements.

ul.li: HIRC Editor can now import a mod package to keep editing it, and re-exports keep its track patches intact
The Browser lists Patch.pck under every language folder instead of only the first
The Mod Manager mod list now has a scrollbar
The GameBanana mod list cache now refreshes instead of staying stale forever
Voice mods targeting Patch.pck now apply to the correct language and no longer disturb the other language
Browser search and navigation now reach sounds inside Patch.pck
A sound duplicated in both a SoundBank/Patch BNK and a streamed PCK is now replaced in both copies
Broken mods are now also relinked when applying, not just on import, and the repaired references are saved into the mod
Mods are automatically relinked when a game update moves a sound to a different PCK, on import, install and export
Merge Streaming PCK is now off by default
Original audio is now kept in StreamingAssets, with Persistent treated as a removable overlay
Unified the per-game voice-over handling into a single hash-based system
Fixed the desktop shortcut failing to be created during install/update
Updates keep a user-chosen install folder and show a styled progress bar
Cancel during install is now responsive
Internal cleanup: import reorganization and dead-code removal

description.p: First Flatpak release of XXAR after the fork from ZZAR/SRAR.

ul.li: Single Flatpak bundle now covers all three supported games
Self-update flow uses sideloaded .flatpak bundles from GitHub releases
